read.thesis: Cloud external revenue up 64% with margin 14.9%, but management cut the long-term 20 GW compute target and FY2028 cloud growth guide to 30-45%, and FCF stays negative to 2H28.

utilisation.quote: The market does remain supply constrained. That is true globally and especially here in China, I think over the next couple of years.

capex.quote: it may lead to a downward revision of that long-term 20 GW target. To that extent, there will also be a certain impact on our overall CapEx plan.

triggers.label: FY28 cloud growth 30-45%
triggers.quote: we might expect our growth target for cloud revenue to be in the 30%-45% range.

triggers.label: 20 GW compute target may be cut
triggers.quote: it may lead to a downward revision of that long-term 20 GW target.

triggers.label: Cloud margin 14.9% on pricing
triggers.quote: benefiting from pricing enhancements amid tight market supply and scale-driven operating leverage.

triggers.label: External cloud revenue +64%
triggers.quote: revenue from external customers in AI Cloud and compute services grew 64% year over year.

triggers.label: Quick commerce halving losses held
triggers.quote: We remain committed to our goal of halving losses next year and achieving profitability in instant retail by fiscal year 2029.

guidance.quote: we might expect our growth target for cloud revenue to be in the 30%-45% range.
we expect cloud revenue growth to rebound to 50% or higher in calendar year 2028.
our targets for calendar year 2030 remain unchanged, achieving $100 billion in external cloud revenue with a margin exceeding 20%.

guidance.value: CNY 30 billion for fiscal year end
guidance.quote: I think that we are very confident in achieving our target of CNY 30 billion in ARR for the full fiscal year.

guidance.value: halve losses next year; profitability by FY2029
guidance.quote: We remain committed to our goal of halving losses next year and achieving profitability in instant retail by fiscal year 2029.
we should be able to achieve positive cash flow overall by 2028 in the second half of that year.

prior_guidance_check.quote: revenue from external customers in AI Cloud and compute services grew 64% year over year.
Adjusted EBITDA increased 121% year over year, and EBITDA margin expanded to 14.5%.

achieving profitability in instant retail by fiscal year 2029.

red_flags.label: Compute export control impact on FY28 plan
red_flags.quote: the new compute export control rules will affect next year's products and services, and there is still uncertainty as regards the supply chain.

red_flags.label: CMR down 5% reported
red_flags.quote: CMR decreasing 5% year-over-year and growing 1% on a like-for-like basis

red_flags.label: FCF outflow CNY 34.5bn
red_flags.quote: Free cash flow was an outflow of CNY 34.5 billion, compared to an outflow of CNY 21.8 billion in the same quarter last year.
